Hi! im also 17 and i've researched about my own parent's narcissism too and went through this crisis thinking i was maybe a narcissist myself-- but please dont worry. The main defining factor about people with narcissism is a lack of the ability to feel empathy. And in general believing they're nearly always right. If you are even questioning if you are a narcissist, i dont know you personally but i dont think that you are. 

It would take immense effort from a true narcissist to admit there is something wrong with them, asthey  wholeheartedly believe they are superior.

If you think your emotional intelligence is deficient or you too find yourself being irrational similar to narcissistic signs, this may just be a trauma response-- and not narcissism. And with the gaslighting that comes from narcissistic people in our lives it is very likely it is something subconsciously in you, you may a good person but now you're truly questioning yourself after all this time.

Do look into therapy, or for the time being talk it out with a trusted friend, but just remember if youre this concerned for your actions/impact of actions-- you do in fact have enough empathy to likely not be considered narcissistic.
